evals.prompt: create a batch of jira tickets from our template
evals.expected_output: Claude verifies the Atlassian MCP, presents the 4 operation patterns, user selects batch_create_from_template, Claude reads the corresponding pattern file and follows it.
assertions: Claude presents all 4 operation patterns to the user
Claude reads patterns/batch_create_from_template.md and follows it exactly
Claude does not proceed without MCP confirmation

evals.prompt: run a hygiene check on our jira board
evals.expected_output: Claude confirms MCP availability, user selects hygiene_check, Claude reads the pattern file and scans tickets for missing or incorrect fields, presenting a report. Optionally auto-fixes on user instruction.
assertions: Claude reads patterns/hygiene_check.md from the manage_jira patterns directory
Claude produces a report of missing or incorrect fields
Claude offers auto-fix only after presenting the report

evals.expected_output: Atlassian MCP is unavailable. Claude stops and instructs the user to run 'make enable_mcp server=Atlassian' and restart Claude Code.
assertions: Claude calls getAccessibleAtlassianResources as the first action
Claude stops immediately when the MCP call fails
Claude tells the user to enable the Atlassian MCP server before retrying
